paper_title: Before Generation, Align it! A Novel and Effective Strategy for   Mitigating Hallucinations in Text-to-SQL Generation
caption: Results of different schema linking modules on BIRD-dev.
model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the performance of different schema linking modules on the BIRD-dev dataset, presenting recall, precision, and F1 scores. The horizontal axis displays three categories: Recall, Precision, and F1 Score, while the vertical axis represents the score value on a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 100, with tick labels at increments of 10. Three different modules are compared: DIN-SQL (zero-shot), TA-SQL (zero-shot), and DIN-SQL (few-shot), each represented by a distinct color—light blue, medium blue, and light green respectively. For the Recall category, the DIN-SQL (zero-shot) bar has a value of 63.58, TA-SQL (zero-shot) has a value of 72.29, and DIN-SQL (few-shot) has a value of 75.34. For the Precision category, the DIN-SQL (zero-shot) bar has a value of 88.89, TA-SQL (zero-shot) has a value of 91.24, and DIN-SQL (few-shot) has a value of 92.31. Finally, for the F1 Score category, the DIN-SQL (zero-shot) bar has a value of 80.40, TA-SQL (zero-shot) has a value of 81.08, and DIN-SQL (few-shot) has a value of 80.40. The bars are arranged sequentially for each category and sorted in ascending order by score across the different models for the ‘Recall’ category, and in ascending order for the other two categories. No bars are visually emphasized beyond the distinct colors representing each module.
